dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: Hehe, I won! Even adults will lose when it comes to cards!

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: Ugh... This one doesn't count! I'll win next time for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can go on adventures without a Vision.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: You mean be one of those martial arts heroes? Hmph, no thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: After the old folks in the village discovered I had an interest in adventuring, they kept bringing me all these martial arts novels...

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: But when I read them, I was disappointed to find that the main characters are all ugly stinking men! Sorry, not my kind of story!

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: You haven't read any before? Here, knock yourself out, they're certainly no use to me!

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: Hey. You look like an adventurer. You got a Vision?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: Aw, that sucks! Nobody remembers the adventurers who don't have Visions.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: Wanna know why? 'Cause when you get a Vision you get to use elemental power, and you can use that to fight evil and become a legend!

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: That's just scratching the surface; Visions give you loads of advantages. Even the books themselves say, the famous adventurers you read about in books are all Vision bearers.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: In short, if you ain't got a Vision, you can forget your dreams of becoming a big hero.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you obsessed with Visions?

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: 'Cause I want one for myself!

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: With a Vision you can get money and status. If I had enough money, mom and dad could come back to the village 'cause they wouldn't need to work in Liyue Harbor anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: I told my friends about Visions, and now they all want one too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not telling you.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: Hmph. Fine. Not like I haven't seen one before anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can control the elements though.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: Impossible! You're a liar; I've read lots of books about this and I have never come across anyone who doesn't need a Vision to use elemental power.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: Don't think I'm gonna fall for your lies just 'cause I'm a kid!
